name: agoo-alert-web
description: Plateforme web de déclaration de pertes - Agoo Alert

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:shared && npm run install:gateway && npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: cd backend/services/auth && npm install && cd ../user && npm install && cd ../publication && npm install && cd ../chat && npm install && cd ../upload && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "GW,AUTH,USER,PUB,CHAT,UPL,ADM,WEB" --prefix-colors "bgBlue,bgGreen,bgYellow,bgMagenta,bgCyan,bgRed,bgWhite,blue" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:publication" "npm run dev:chat" "npm run dev:upload" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:frontend"
